why: Isomorphic Labs raising $5 billion in Series C funding marks the largest private financing round in biotech history, coming only six months after its $2.1 billion Series B. Backed by Greenoaks, Sequoia Capital, and parent company Alphabet, the capital accelerates clinical trials for AI-designed therapeutics and scales its IsoDDE engine. The milestone represents a major shift toward commercial and clinical validation for AI drug discovery with confirmed primary documentation and extensive global coverage.
